description: The full category tree with the category_id every search filter takes.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description:
**List only the subtree rooted at this category, instead of the whole taxonomy.** Optional; a `category_id` from this same endpoint (e.g. `13` Coches, `131` Venta de pisos, `111` Móviles).

- Every node under the id is returned, including the id itself, with the tree pruned above it; a leaf id returns just that node.
- An id that names no category in the tree is a 404  -  take ids from a call without `parent_id`, or from `/search-categories`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
**Shape of the `categories` array.** Optional; default `tree`.

- `tree`  -  nested nodes, each with its own `children` array (the Milanuncios category menu); use it to render a drill-down menu.
- `flat`  -  every node in one list, each with `depth` (`0` = top-level vertical) and `path` (the ids from the top-level vertical down to the node, inclusive) instead of `children`; use it for a breadcrumb or a searchable list.

description: Turn a word like "piso" or "iphone" into matching category ids and suggested searches.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**A word or phrase to match against category names and Milanuncios keyword suggestions.** Required; 1 - 100 characters. Ex: `piso` (flats), `iphone`, `bicicleta`.

- Matched against the Spanish category names, case-insensitive and insensitive to vowel accents (`camion` = `camión`)  -  but not to `ñ`: type `muñecas`, not `munecas`.
- A query that matches nothing  -  including one with no letter or digit (`%`, `+`, an emoji)  -  returns empty `categories` and `suggestions` arrays with HTTP 200, not an error.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (``) or file paths is refused with 400.

- Take it from `/categories` or `/search-categories`, or from `category.category_id` on any listing; a leaf or make id (e.g. `814` Ferrari) works too.
- An alias node of `/categories` (one with `alias_of` set, e.g. `1890` Remolques → `50`) answers its target's form, with `alias_of` naming the target.
- An id that is not a category returns 404.

description: Autocomplete a place name into province, region and city ids for search.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**A place name to autocomplete.** Required; 2 - 100 characters. Ex: `valencia`, `málaga`, `madridejos`.

- Matches provinces, autonomous regions and towns/cities, case-insensitive and insensitive to vowel accents (`malaga` = `málaga`)  -  but not to `ñ`: type `a coruña`, not `a coruna`.
- Neighbourhoods are not matched (`barrio de salamanca` matches nothing): list a town's neighbourhoods with `/city-zones`.
- A query that matches nothing  -  including one with no letter or digit (`%%`, an emoji)  -  returns an empty `locations` array with HTTP 200, not an error.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (``) or file paths is refused with 400.

- An INE municipality code is not the same id and will not match.
- A `city_id` naming no town returns 404; a real town without zones returns 200 with an empty `zones` list.

description: Autocomplete a street address into place ids for geocoding.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**A street address, landmark or place fragment to autocomplete.** Required; 1 - 200 characters. Ex: `gran via madrid`.

- Spain-wide street-level autocomplete (finer-grained than `/locations`, which resolves provinces, regions and towns only)  -  the entry point for turning a free-text address into coordinates via `/geocode`.
- A query that matches nothing  -  including one with no letter or digit (`%`, an emoji)  -  returns an empty `results` array with HTTP 200, not an error.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (``) or file paths is refused with 400.

description: Coordinates, postcode, city and province for a place_id from /address-search.

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description:
**The opaque place token to resolve.** Required; the `place_id` returned by `/address-search` for a chosen suggestion. Ex: `EhFHcmFuIFbDrWEsIE1hZHJpZCIuKiwKFAoSCTPfo219KEINESFdTIltQBnhEhQKEgmBPAqAlylCDRFpIoxhwd42xA` (Gran Vía, Madrid).

- Tokens may expire: take a fresh one from `/address-search` rather than storing it long-term.
- A malformed value (anything but letters, digits, `_` and `-`, or over 1,000 characters) is a 400; a well-formed value that names no place in Spain returns 404.

description: Address, city and province ids for a latitude/longitude in Spain.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description:
**Latitude of the point to reverse-geocode.** Required; decimal degrees, `-90` - `90`. Ex: `40.4168` (Madrid, Puerta del Sol).

- Send with `longitude` as a pair  -  from a map tap, a device GPS fix, or `latitude`/`longitude` on a `/geocode` response.
- Milanuncios covers Spain only: a point outside Spain returns 404.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description:
**Longitude of the point to reverse-geocode.** Required; decimal degrees, `-180` - `180`. Ex: `-3.7038` (Madrid, Puerta del Sol).

- Send with `latitude` as a pair.
- Milanuncios covers Spain only: a point outside Spain returns 404.

latitude.description:
**Latitude of the point to reverse-geocode.** Required; decimal degrees, `-90` - `90`. Ex: `40.4168` (Madrid, Puerta del Sol).

- Send with `longitude` as a pair  -  from a map tap, a device GPS fix, or `latitude`/`longitude` on a `/geocode` response.
- Milanuncios covers Spain only: a point outside Spain returns 404.

description: Search listings across every category with the full filter set, sorted and paginated.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**Free-text keywords, matched against listing titles and descriptions.** Optional; up to 200 characters. Ex: `bmw`.

- Spanish words match best: `piso` (flat), `iphone 13`, `cabrio`, `bicicleta`.
- Combine with `category_id` to keep a broad word inside one category; `/search-categories` turns a word into category ids.
- Add `sort=relevance` for the best matches first.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description:
**Category to search in, by numeric category id.** Optional; omit to search every category.

Take ids from `/categories` (the full tree) or `/search-categories` (word → category). Any level works  -  a vertical, a sub-category or a car-make leaf:

- `1` Motor (all vehicles) · `13` Coches (cars) · `14` Motos (motorbikes) · `814` Ferrari (a make leaf)
- `32` Inmobiliaria (real estate) · `131` Venta de pisos (flats for sale) · `132` Alquiler de pisos (flats for rent)
- `83` Telefonía · `111` Móviles (mobile phones) · `3` Empleo (jobs)

`/category-filters` lists which filters a category honours and every accepted value. An alias node of `/categories` (one with `alias_of` set, e.g. `1890` Remolques → `50`) is searched as its target, and `filters_applied.category_id` echoes the target.

parameters.name: listing_ids
parameters.description:
**Only these listings, by listing id  -  a bulk card lookup.** Optional; comma-separated, up to 100 ids of 5 - 12 digits. Ex: `616718822,612051892`.

- Returns the card of every id still published; sold, removed or expired ids are absent (compare `returned` with the ids sent).
- Rows follow `sort` and combine with every other filter (e.g. `price_dropped_only=true` keeps only the reduced ones).
- A malformed id, or more than 100, is refused with 400.
- With more than one id, `reserve_status` is `null` on every row: send one id, or call `/listing`, for a listing's status.
- `price_indicators` and `financing_offers` stay empty for this lookup; each listing's own rating and offer are on `/listing`.

parameters.name: province_id
parameters.description:
**Province, by its Spanish INE province code.** Optional; `1` - `52`; omit for all of Spain.

- `28` Madrid · `8` Barcelona · `46` Valencia · `41` Sevilla · `29` Málaga · `51` Ceuta · `52` Melilla
- Look a place name up with `/locations` (it returns `province_id`, `region_id` and `city_id`).
- Intersects with `city_id` / `zone_id`: combine only places inside the province.
- Also matches listings advertised in the province as an extra province (`extra_provinces` on the row), so it can return more than `region_id` for the same single-province region.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description:
**Autonomous community (region), by region id.** Optional; searches a multi-province region at once.

- `54` Cataluña · `55` Andalucía · `57` Comunidad Valenciana · `53` Galicia · `59` País Vasco
- `60` Castilla-La Mancha · `61` Castilla y León · `62` Canarias
- Single-province regions reuse the province code (Comunidad de Madrid = `28`); get ids from `/locations` (`region_id`).
- Matches each listing's main location only (unlike `province_id`, which also matches extra provinces).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description:
**City (locality), by Milanuncios locality id.** Optional. Ex: `44` (Madrid).

- Get it from `city_id` on a `/locations` row of `type: locality`, or from `/reverse-geocode` for a coordinate.
- **Not the INE municipality code**: an INE code names a different place or nothing.
- For a neighbourhood inside the city, add `zone_id`.

parameters.name: zone_id
parameters.description:
**Neighbourhood (zone) inside a city, by zone id.** Optional; **requires `city_id`**. Ex: `705` (Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid).

- List a city's zones with `/city-zones?city_id=…` (a city without zones returns an empty list).
- The zone must belong to `city_id`: an unknown zone, or a zone of another city, is refused with 400.
- Mostly useful for real estate.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description:
**Latitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `40.4168` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_m` **together**; one or two alone is refused with 400.
- Get coordinates from `/geocode` (for a `place_id` from `/address-search`) or use your own; `/reverse-geocode` turns a point into `city_id` / `province_id`.
- Required by `sort=distance`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description:
**Longitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `-3.7038` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send together with `latitude` and `radius_m` (all three or none; a partial set is refused with 400).
- West of Greenwich is negative: mainland Spain spans roughly `-9.3` to `3.3`, the Canary Islands about `-18.2` to `-13.4`.

parameters.name: radius_m
parameters.description:
**Radius of the search circle around `latitude`/`longitude`, in METRES (not km).** Optional; `1` - `500000`.

- `1000`  -  1 km (a neighbourhood) · `5000`  -  5 km (a city district)
- `20000`  -  20 km (a metro area) · `100000`  -  100 km (a province)
- Send together with `latitude` and `longitude` (all three or none).
- With `sort=distance` rows come nearest first and carry `distance_m`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `1000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. Any `price_min` of `1` or more leaves them out.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `30000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. They are always inside a `price_max`, and `price_max=0` selects exactly them.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: financed_price_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: financed_price_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description:
**Who is selling.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `private`  -  private individual (particular)
- `professional`  -  business account: dealer, estate agency or shop

Each row reports it as `seller.type`; a professional seller's store is reachable through `/store`.

parameters.name: ad_type
parameters.description:
**Listing direction: offering something, or looking for it.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `offer`  -  something for sale, for rent or on offer (the vast majority)
- `wanted`  -  a "se busca / compro" ad from someone looking for the item

Each row carries the source's own code in `ad_type` (`supply` for `offer`, `demand` for `wanted`, as Milanuncios serves it).

parameters.name: published_within_days
parameters.description:
**Only listings first published within the last N calendar days.** Optional; whole days, `0` - `3650`. Every category.

- `0`  -  today · `1`  -  today and yesterday · `7`  -  the last week · `30`  -  about the last month
- Filters the original publication date (`published_at`): a listing renewed (bumped) recently but first published earlier does not match. For recently renewed listings read `renewed_at` in the default `recent` order (on featured rows it can be later than `updated_at`).
- Pair with `published_before_days` for a window of whole days.

parameters.name: published_before_days
parameters.description:
**Only listings first published N or more calendar days ago**  -  on or before the day N days ago. Optional; whole days, `1` - `3650`. Every category.

- `1`  -  everything except today's listings · `30`  -  listed for about a month or more
- With `published_within_days` it selects a window of whole calendar days (both `3` = the listings published on the day three days ago).
- A value greater than `published_within_days` is refused with 400.
- Day windows split a search larger than the pageable window (8,300 results) into parts that can each be paged in full.

parameters.name: price_dropped_only
parameters.description:
**Only listings whose price was cut** (the row carries `previous_price` above `price`, and `price_drop`). Optional; every category.

- `true` keeps only reduced listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter**.
- A listing whose price was withdrawn also counts as reduced: it comes back with `price: 0`, its old `previous_price` and `price_drop: null`.
- `/price-drops` is the same search with this filter always on.

parameters.name: shippable_only
parameters.description:
**Only listings that can be bought with Milanuncios shipping (Milanuncios Express).** Optional.

- `true` keeps only shippable listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter** (shippable listings are not excluded).
- Mostly relevant to second-hand goods; `/listing-shipping` gives a listing's methods and buyer cost.

parameters.name: item_condition
parameters.description:
**Condition of a second-hand item.** Optional. Ex: `new,like_new`.

- `new`  -  brand new, unused (sin estrenar)
- `like_new`  -  practically new
- `good`  -  in good condition
- `acceptable`  -  acceptable, visible wear
- `poor`  -  needs repair / improvable (mejorable)

- Applies to second-hand goods (phones `111`, computing `2`, home and garden `30`, fashion `43` …); vehicles and real estate carry no item condition.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description:
**Vehicle make, by name as Milanuncios spells it (lower-case).** Optional; ONE make per request. Ex: `seat`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Spelling matters (`alfa romeo`, `land-rover`, `mercedes-benz`): the full list (value = what to send) is in `/category-filters?category_id=13` (cars) or `14` (motorbikes).
- A comma-separated list is refused with 400: run one search per make, or search the make's leaf `category_id`.
- A multi-word make is matched word by word, so it also catches makes sharing a word (`royal alloy` = `royal`, `mv agusta` = `mv`), and `land rover` (space) differs from `land-rover`. For an exact make use its leaf `category_id` (`814` Ferrari, `846` Seat  -  `/search-categories` finds it).
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description:
**Vehicle model name(s) within `brand`, lower-case.** Optional; send together with `brand`. Ex: `ibiza`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Free text, spelt as the model name appears in listing titles (`leon`, `serie 3`, `golf`).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result. `ibiza,leon` returns both models.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

parameters.name: year_min
parameters.description:
**Earliest model year of the vehicle.** Optional; `1900` - `2100`. Ex: `2015`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: year_max
parameters.description:
**Latest model year of the vehicle.** Optional; `1900` - `2100`. Ex: `2019`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: mileage_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum mileage, in kilometres.** Optional. Ex: `50000`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: mileage_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum mileage, in kilometres.** Optional. Ex: `10000` (nearly new).

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: power_hp_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum engine power, in horsepower (CV).** Optional. Ex: `200`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: power_hp_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum engine power, in horsepower (CV).** Optional. Ex: `120`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: engine_cc_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum engine displacement, in cubic centimetres (cc).** Optional; most useful for motorbikes (`14`). Ex: `500`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: engine_cc_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum engine displacement, in cubic centimetres (cc).** Optional; most useful for motorbikes (`14`). Ex: `125` (A1 / car-licence bikes).

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description:
**Fuel type.** Optional. Ex: `diesel,gasoline`.

- `diesel`  -  diesel (diésel)
- `gasoline`  -  petrol (gasolina)
- `electric`  -  battery electric
- `hybrid`  -  hybrid
- `plug_in_hybrid`  -  plug-in hybrid
- `glp`  -  LPG (gas licuado)
- `other`  -  anything else

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description:
**Gearbox.** Optional; omit for both.

- `manual`  -  manual gearbox
- `automatic`  -  automatic gearbox

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.

parameters.name: doors
parameters.description:
**Number of doors, exactly.** Optional; one value, `2` - `5`. Ex: `5`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- One value per request: to cover 3- and 5-door cars, run two searches (or omit the filter).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description:
**Colour, by its Spanish name.** Optional. Ex: `negro,blanco`.

- Vehicles and boats: `amarillo` (yellow), `azul` (blue), `beige`, `blanco` (white), `dorado` (gold), `granate` (maroon), `gris` (grey), `lila` (lilac), `marron` (brown), `naranja` (orange), `negro` (black), `plata` (silver), `rojo` (red), `verde` (green), `violeta` (violet)
- Goods also offer: `azul_claro` (light blue), `cobre` (copper), `multicolor`, `rosa` (pink), `turquesa` (turquoise), `verde_claro` (light green)
- Applies to every category whose search form has a colour: vehicles (cars, motorbikes, vans, trucks, boats …) and many goods categories (fashion `43`, home, sport …)  -  check `/category-filters`.
- Matched as text against the colour the seller typed, so a free-text colour such as "azul (negro con franjas)" also matches `negro`, and a name outside these lists matches almost nothing.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: environmental_label
parameters.description:
**Spanish DGT environmental sticker**, which decides access to low-emission zones. Optional. Ex: `eco,c`.

- `zero`  -  CERO (electric)
- `eco`  -  ECO (hybrids, gas)
- `c`  -  C (recent petrol and diesel)
- `b`  -  B (older petrol and diesel)
- `none`  -  no sticker (shown on the site as "Etiqueta A")

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: seats
parameters.description:
**Number of seats.** Optional; values `2` - `9`. Ex: `2,4`.

- `2` two-seaters · `5` · `7` people carriers · `9` minibuses
- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: with_warranty
parameters.description:
**Only vehicles sold with a warranty.** Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- `true` keeps only listings that include a warranty; `false` or omitted means **no filter** (warrantied listings are not excluded).

parameters.name: brand_certified
parameters.description:
**Only manufacturer-certified used vehicles** (brand-approved used programmes). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- `true` keeps only certified listings (a small share); `false` or omitted means **no filter** (certified listings are not excluded).

parameters.name: boat_length_min_m
parameters.description:
**Minimum boat length (eslora), in whole METRES.** Optional; a decimal is refused. Ex: `8`.

- Applies to boats (`696` Barcos and its sub-categories); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.ship_length`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

- Applies to boats (`696` Barcos and its sub-categories); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.ship_length`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: load_capacity_min_kg
parameters.description:

- Applies to vans (`16` Furgonetas); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.load_capacity`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: load_capacity_max_kg
parameters.description:

- Applies to vans (`16` Furgonetas); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.load_capacity`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: axles_min
parameters.description:

- Applies to trucks (`17` Camiones); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.axles`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: max_weight_min_kg
parameters.description:

- Applies to caravans and motorhomes (`46` Caravanas); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.max_weight`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: max_weight_max_kg
parameters.description:
**Maximum maximum authorised mass (MMA), in KILOGRAMS.** Optional. Ex: `3500` (drivable on a standard car licence).

- Applies to caravans and motorhomes (`46` Caravanas); listings of other categories do not match. Rows carry it as `specs.max_weight`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: surface_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum built surface, in square metres (m²).** Optional. Ex: `80`.

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: surface_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum built surface, in square metres (m²).** Optional. Ex: `100`.

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: bedrooms_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum number of bedrooms.** Optional; `0` - `1000`. Ex: `2` (the site's "1+" … "4+" buttons are `1` - `4`).

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: bedrooms_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum number of bedrooms.** Optional; `0` - `1000`. Ex: `1` (studios and one-bedroom flats).

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: bathrooms_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum number of bathrooms.** Optional; `0` - `1000`. Ex: `2`.

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: bathrooms_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum number of bathrooms.** Optional; `0` - `1000`. Ex: `1`.

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: floor
parameters.description:
**Which floor the property is on.** Optional. Ex: `floor_1,floor_2`.

- `basement`  -  basement (sótano)
- `semi_basement`  -  semi-basement (semisótano)
- `ground`  -  ground floor (bajo)
- `mezzanine`  -  mezzanine (entresuelo)
- `floor_1` … `floor_19`  -  that floor exactly
- `floor_20_29`, `floor_30_39`, `floor_40_49`, `floor_50_79`, `floor_80_100`  -  high-rise bands

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description:
**Property extras that must ALL be present.** Optional. Ex: `elevator,terrace` (lift AND terrace).

- `elevator`  -  lift (ascensor)
- `garage`  -  garage / parking space
- `terrace`  -  terrace
- `heating`  -  heating (calefacción)
- `swimming_pool`  -  swimming pool
- `garden`  -  garden
- `furnished`  -  furnished (amueblado)
- `storage_room`  -  storage room (trastero)
- `air_conditioning`  -  air conditioning
- `internet`  -  internet
- `pets_allowed`  -  pets allowed (flats and holiday rentals `1040`)
- `smoke_exit`  -  smoke outlet (commercial premises `349`, warehouses `130`)
- `automatic_door`  -  automatic door (garage spaces `160`)
- `private_vigilance`  -  security guard (garage spaces `160`)
- `load_unload_area`  -  loading/unloading area (zona de carga y descarga)
- `hours_24_days_365`  -  accessible 24 h, 365 days (storage rooms `1520`, `1530`, `1540`)

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Comma-separated, and **unlike every other multi-value filter these combine with AND**: a listing must have every feature listed, so each extra value narrows the result.
- Each row lists what it has in `extras`, keyed and valued as Milanuncios serves them (e.g. `storage_room` with `value` `Yes`); these keys are not always the spelling this filter takes.

parameters.name: beach_distance_min_m
parameters.description:
**Minimum distance to the beach, in METRES**  -  for "at least N m from the sea". Optional. Ex: `1000`.

- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Pair with `beach_distance_max_m` for a band, and with a coastal `province_id` or `city_id`.
- Only listings that state a beach distance can match (most do not), so even `0` keeps only those.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: beach_distance_max_m
parameters.description:
**Maximum distance to the beach, in METRES.** Optional. Ex: `400` (a short walk).

- `100`  -  beachfront · `400`  -  a short walk · `1000`  -  within 1 km · `5000`  -  within 5 km
- The site offers `10`, `50`, `100`, `200`, `400`, `800`, `1000`, `5000`, `10000` and `50000`; any whole number of metres is accepted.
- Applies to real-estate categories (Inmobiliaria `32`: flats for sale `131`, flats for rent `132`, houses for sale `768` …).
- Only listings that state a beach distance can match (most do not); pair with a coastal `province_id` or `city_id`.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: garage_type
parameters.description:
**Size of a garage space.** Optional; one of the values below (any other value is refused with 400).

- `car`  -  a space for a car (plaza de coche)
- `motorcycle`  -  a space for a motorbike (plaza de moto)

- Applies to garage spaces (`160` Plazas de garaje); listings of other categories do not match.
- Rows carry it as `specs.garage_type`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
**Result order.** Optional; default `recent`.

- `recent`  -  featured (highlighted) listings first, then the most recently published or renewed
- `relevance`  -  best keyword match first (exact title matches lead); needs `query`, else it equals `recent`. **With a `query`, pages are not stable**: equal-score listings change order between requests, so paging can repeat some rows and skip others. Use it for the first pages; for a complete crawl use `recent` or a price sort
- `price_asc`  -  cheapest first; **leaves out listings priced 0 €** (no price, `price: 0`) **and 1 €** (often a "price on request" placeholder)
- `price_desc`  -  most expensive first; keeps every listing, priceless ones (`price: 0`) last
- `year_desc` / `year_asc`  -  newest / oldest model year first
- `mileage_asc`  -  lowest mileage first
- `surface_desc`  -  largest surface first (real estate); surfaces are owner-entered, so implausible values can lead, including placeholder surfaces such as `square_meters: 2147483647`; rows without a surface come last
- `length_desc`  -  longest boat first (boats; lengths as sellers typed them, so a few absurd values lead)
- `distance`  -  nearest to `latitude`/`longitude` first; **requires** `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_m` (400 without them); rows carry `distance_m`

`year_desc` / `year_asc` leave out listings that state no model year and `mileage_asc` those that state no mileage, and `total` shrinks accordingly: they suit vehicle categories (and boats, for the year), and elsewhere return few or no results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
**How many listings to return per page.** Optional; default `30`; `1` - `100` (above 100 is refused with 400).

- `100` needs the fewest calls for a crawl.
- Only the first 8,300 results of a search can be paged (see `offset`); read `returned` for what came back.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
**How many results to skip  -  the paging cursor.** Optional; default `0`; `0` - `8200`.

- Pass the previous response's `next_offset` for the next page (`null` means there is no further page).
- **Only the first 8,300 results can be paged:** the deepest `offset` is 8,200, plus one page of up to `limit` rows  -  request that last page with `limit=100` to reach all 8,300. A deeper offset is refused with 400.
- Near the end of the window `next_offset` stays at 8,200, so the last page can repeat rows: de-duplicate by `listing_id`.
- To reach further, split the search (price bands, `province_id`, a `published_within_days` + `published_before_days` day window) or run it in both price orders.

query.description:
**Free-text keywords, matched against listing titles and descriptions.** Optional; up to 200 characters. Ex: `bmw`.

- Spanish words match best: `piso` (flat), `iphone 13`, `cabrio`, `bicicleta`.
- Combine with `category_id` to keep a broad word inside one category; `/search-categories` turns a word into category ids.
- Add `sort=relevance` for the best matches first.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

category_id.description:
**Category to search in, by numeric category id.** Optional; omit to search every category.

Take ids from `/categories` (the full tree) or `/search-categories` (word → category). Any level works  -  a vertical, a sub-category or a car-make leaf:

- `1` Motor (all vehicles) · `13` Coches (cars) · `14` Motos (motorbikes) · `814` Ferrari (a make leaf)
- `32` Inmobiliaria (real estate) · `131` Venta de pisos (flats for sale) · `132` Alquiler de pisos (flats for rent)
- `83` Telefonía · `111` Móviles (mobile phones) · `3` Empleo (jobs)

`/category-filters` lists which filters a category honours and every accepted value. An alias node of `/categories` (one with `alias_of` set, e.g. `1890` Remolques → `50`) is searched as its target, and `filters_applied.category_id` echoes the target.

listing_ids.description:
**Only these listings, by listing id  -  a bulk card lookup.** Optional; comma-separated, up to 100 ids of 5 - 12 digits. Ex: `616718822,612051892`.

- Returns the card of every id still published; sold, removed or expired ids are absent (compare `returned` with the ids sent).
- Rows follow `sort` and combine with every other filter (e.g. `price_dropped_only=true` keeps only the reduced ones).
- A malformed id, or more than 100, is refused with 400.
- With more than one id, `reserve_status` is `null` on every row: send one id, or call `/listing`, for a listing's status.
- `price_indicators` and `financing_offers` stay empty for this lookup; each listing's own rating and offer are on `/listing`.

province_id.description:
**Province, by its Spanish INE province code.** Optional; `1` - `52`; omit for all of Spain.

- `28` Madrid · `8` Barcelona · `46` Valencia · `41` Sevilla · `29` Málaga · `51` Ceuta · `52` Melilla
- Look a place name up with `/locations` (it returns `province_id`, `region_id` and `city_id`).
- Intersects with `city_id` / `zone_id`: combine only places inside the province.
- Also matches listings advertised in the province as an extra province (`extra_provinces` on the row), so it can return more than `region_id` for the same single-province region.

region_id.description:
**Autonomous community (region), by region id.** Optional; searches a multi-province region at once.

- `54` Cataluña · `55` Andalucía · `57` Comunidad Valenciana · `53` Galicia · `59` País Vasco
- `60` Castilla-La Mancha · `61` Castilla y León · `62` Canarias
- Single-province regions reuse the province code (Comunidad de Madrid = `28`); get ids from `/locations` (`region_id`).
- Matches each listing's main location only (unlike `province_id`, which also matches extra provinces).

city_id.description:
**City (locality), by Milanuncios locality id.** Optional. Ex: `44` (Madrid).

- Get it from `city_id` on a `/locations` row of `type: locality`, or from `/reverse-geocode` for a coordinate.
- **Not the INE municipality code**: an INE code names a different place or nothing.
- For a neighbourhood inside the city, add `zone_id`.

zone_id.description:
**Neighbourhood (zone) inside a city, by zone id.** Optional; **requires `city_id`**. Ex: `705` (Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid).

- List a city's zones with `/city-zones?city_id=…` (a city without zones returns an empty list).
- The zone must belong to `city_id`: an unknown zone, or a zone of another city, is refused with 400.
- Mostly useful for real estate.

latitude.description:
**Latitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `40.4168` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_m` **together**; one or two alone is refused with 400.
- Get coordinates from `/geocode` (for a `place_id` from `/address-search`) or use your own; `/reverse-geocode` turns a point into `city_id` / `province_id`.
- Required by `sort=distance`.

longitude.description:
**Longitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `-3.7038` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send together with `latitude` and `radius_m` (all three or none; a partial set is refused with 400).
- West of Greenwich is negative: mainland Spain spans roughly `-9.3` to `3.3`, the Canary Islands about `-18.2` to `-13.4`.

radius_m.description:
**Radius of the search circle around `latitude`/`longitude`, in METRES (not km).** Optional; `1` - `500000`.

- `1000`  -  1 km (a neighbourhood) · `5000`  -  5 km (a city district)
- `20000`  -  20 km (a metro area) · `100000`  -  100 km (a province)
- Send together with `latitude` and `longitude` (all three or none).
- With `sort=distance` rows come nearest first and carry `distance_m`.

price_min.description:
**Minimum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `1000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. Any `price_min` of `1` or more leaves them out.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

price_max.description:
**Maximum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `30000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. They are always inside a `price_max`, and `price_max=0` selects exactly them.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

financed_price_min.description:
**Minimum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

financed_price_max.description:
**Maximum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

seller_type.description:
**Who is selling.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `private`  -  private individual (particular)
- `professional`  -  business account: dealer, estate agency or shop

Each row reports it as `seller.type`; a professional seller's store is reachable through `/store`.

ad_type.description:
**Listing direction: offering something, or looking for it.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `offer`  -  something for sale, for rent or on offer (the vast majority)
- `wanted`  -  a "se busca / compro" ad from someone looking for the item

Each row carries the source's own code in `ad_type` (`supply` for `offer`, `demand` for `wanted`, as Milanuncios serves it).

published_within_days.description:
**Only listings first published within the last N calendar days.** Optional; whole days, `0` - `3650`. Every category.

- `0`  -  today · `1`  -  today and yesterday · `7`  -  the last week · `30`  -  about the last month
- Filters the original publication date (`published_at`): a listing renewed (bumped) recently but first published earlier does not match. For recently renewed listings read `renewed_at` in the default `recent` order (on featured rows it can be later than `updated_at`).
- Pair with `published_before_days` for a window of whole days.

published_before_days.description:
**Only listings first published N or more calendar days ago**  -  on or before the day N days ago. Optional; whole days, `1` - `3650`. Every category.

- `1`  -  everything except today's listings · `30`  -  listed for about a month or more
- With `published_within_days` it selects a window of whole calendar days (both `3` = the listings published on the day three days ago).
- A value greater than `published_within_days` is refused with 400.
- Day windows split a search larger than the pageable window (8,300 results) into parts that can each be paged in full.

price_dropped_only.description:
**Only listings whose price was cut** (the row carries `previous_price` above `price`, and `price_drop`). Optional; every category.

- `true` keeps only reduced listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter**.
- A listing whose price was withdrawn also counts as reduced: it comes back with `price: 0`, its old `previous_price` and `price_drop: null`.
- `/price-drops` is the same search with this filter always on.

shippable_only.description:
**Only listings that can be bought with Milanuncios shipping (Milanuncios Express).** Optional.

- `true` keeps only shippable listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter** (shippable listings are not excluded).
- Mostly relevant to second-hand goods; `/listing-shipping` gives a listing's methods and buyer cost.

item_condition.description:
**Condition of a second-hand item.** Optional. Ex: `new,like_new`.

- `new`  -  brand new, unused (sin estrenar)
- `like_new`  -  practically new
- `good`  -  in good condition
- `acceptable`  -  acceptable, visible wear
- `poor`  -  needs repair / improvable (mejorable)

- Applies to second-hand goods (phones `111`, computing `2`, home and garden `30`, fashion `43` …); vehicles and real estate carry no item condition.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

brand.description:
**Vehicle make, by name as Milanuncios spells it (lower-case).** Optional; ONE make per request. Ex: `seat`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Spelling matters (`alfa romeo`, `land-rover`, `mercedes-benz`): the full list (value = what to send) is in `/category-filters?category_id=13` (cars) or `14` (motorbikes).
- A comma-separated list is refused with 400: run one search per make, or search the make's leaf `category_id`.
- A multi-word make is matched word by word, so it also catches makes sharing a word (`royal alloy` = `royal`, `mv agusta` = `mv`), and `land rover` (space) differs from `land-rover`. For an exact make use its leaf `category_id` (`814` Ferrari, `846` Seat  -  `/search-categories` finds it).
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

model.description:
**Vehicle model name(s) within `brand`, lower-case.** Optional; send together with `brand`. Ex: `ibiza`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Free text, spelt as the model name appears in listing titles (`leon`, `serie 3`, `golf`).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result. `ibiza,leon` returns both models.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

- Applies to garage spaces (`160` Plazas de garaje); listings of other categories do not match.
- Rows carry it as `specs.garage_type`.

sort.description:
**Result order.** Optional; default `recent`.

- `recent`  -  featured (highlighted) listings first, then the most recently published or renewed
- `relevance`  -  best keyword match first (exact title matches lead); needs `query`, else it equals `recent`. **With a `query`, pages are not stable**: equal-score listings change order between requests, so paging can repeat some rows and skip others. Use it for the first pages; for a complete crawl use `recent` or a price sort
- `price_asc`  -  cheapest first; **leaves out listings priced 0 €** (no price, `price: 0`) **and 1 €** (often a "price on request" placeholder)
- `price_desc`  -  most expensive first; keeps every listing, priceless ones (`price: 0`) last
- `year_desc` / `year_asc`  -  newest / oldest model year first
- `mileage_asc`  -  lowest mileage first
- `surface_desc`  -  largest surface first (real estate); surfaces are owner-entered, so implausible values can lead, including placeholder surfaces such as `square_meters: 2147483647`; rows without a surface come last
- `length_desc`  -  longest boat first (boats; lengths as sellers typed them, so a few absurd values lead)
- `distance`  -  nearest to `latitude`/`longitude` first; **requires** `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_m` (400 without them); rows carry `distance_m`

`year_desc` / `year_asc` leave out listings that state no model year and `mileage_asc` those that state no mileage, and `total` shrinks accordingly: they suit vehicle categories (and boats, for the year), and elsewhere return few or no results.

limit.description:
**How many listings to return per page.** Optional; default `30`; `1` - `100` (above 100 is refused with 400).

- `100` needs the fewest calls for a crawl.
- Only the first 8,300 results of a search can be paged (see `offset`); read `returned` for what came back.

offset.description:
**How many results to skip  -  the paging cursor.** Optional; default `0`; `0` - `8200`.

- Pass the previous response's `next_offset` for the next page (`null` means there is no further page).
- **Only the first 8,300 results can be paged:** the deepest `offset` is 8,200, plus one page of up to `limit` rows  -  request that last page with `limit=100` to reach all 8,300. A deeper offset is refused with 400.
- Near the end of the window `next_offset` stays at 8,200, so the last page can repeat rows: de-duplicate by `listing_id`.
- To reach further, split the search (price bands, `province_id`, a `published_within_days` + `published_before_days` day window) or run it in both price orders.

description: How the matches of a search split across child categories.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
**Keywords to count, matched against listing titles and descriptions.** Required; up to 200 characters. Ex: `iphone`.

- Category counts exist for keyword searches only; for the total of a filter set without keywords, read `total` from `/search`.
- Spanish words match best: `piso`, `coche`, `bicicleta`, `iphone 13`.
- Text containing HTML/script markup or file paths is refused with 400.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description:
**Category to search in, by numeric category id.** Optional; omit to search every category.

Take ids from `/categories` (the full tree) or `/search-categories` (word → category). Any level works  -  a vertical, a sub-category or a car-make leaf:

- `1` Motor (all vehicles) · `13` Coches (cars) · `14` Motos (motorbikes) · `814` Ferrari (a make leaf)
- `32` Inmobiliaria (real estate) · `131` Venta de pisos (flats for sale) · `132` Alquiler de pisos (flats for rent)
- `83` Telefonía · `111` Móviles (mobile phones) · `3` Empleo (jobs)

`/category-filters` lists which filters a category honours and every accepted value. An alias node of `/categories` (one with `alias_of` set, e.g. `1890` Remolques → `50`) is searched as its target, and `filters_applied.category_id` echoes the target.

parameters.name: listing_ids
parameters.description:
**Only these listings, by listing id  -  a bulk card lookup.** Optional; comma-separated, up to 100 ids of 5 - 12 digits. Ex: `616718822,612051892`.

- Returns the card of every id still published; sold, removed or expired ids are absent (compare `returned` with the ids sent).
- Rows follow `sort` and combine with every other filter (e.g. `price_dropped_only=true` keeps only the reduced ones).
- A malformed id, or more than 100, is refused with 400.
- With more than one id, `reserve_status` is `null` on every row: send one id, or call `/listing`, for a listing's status.
- `price_indicators` and `financing_offers` stay empty for this lookup; each listing's own rating and offer are on `/listing`.

parameters.name: province_id
parameters.description:
**Province, by its Spanish INE province code.** Optional; `1` - `52`; omit for all of Spain.

- `28` Madrid · `8` Barcelona · `46` Valencia · `41` Sevilla · `29` Málaga · `51` Ceuta · `52` Melilla
- Look a place name up with `/locations` (it returns `province_id`, `region_id` and `city_id`).
- Intersects with `city_id` / `zone_id`: combine only places inside the province.
- Also matches listings advertised in the province as an extra province (`extra_provinces` on the row), so it can return more than `region_id` for the same single-province region.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description:
**Autonomous community (region), by region id.** Optional; searches a multi-province region at once.

- `54` Cataluña · `55` Andalucía · `57` Comunidad Valenciana · `53` Galicia · `59` País Vasco
- `60` Castilla-La Mancha · `61` Castilla y León · `62` Canarias
- Single-province regions reuse the province code (Comunidad de Madrid = `28`); get ids from `/locations` (`region_id`).
- Matches each listing's main location only (unlike `province_id`, which also matches extra provinces).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description:
**City (locality), by Milanuncios locality id.** Optional. Ex: `44` (Madrid).

- Get it from `city_id` on a `/locations` row of `type: locality`, or from `/reverse-geocode` for a coordinate.
- **Not the INE municipality code**: an INE code names a different place or nothing.
- For a neighbourhood inside the city, add `zone_id`.

parameters.name: zone_id
parameters.description:
**Neighbourhood (zone) inside a city, by zone id.** Optional; **requires `city_id`**. Ex: `705` (Barrio de Salamanca, Madrid).

- List a city's zones with `/city-zones?city_id=…` (a city without zones returns an empty list).
- The zone must belong to `city_id`: an unknown zone, or a zone of another city, is refused with 400.
- Mostly useful for real estate.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description:
**Latitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `40.4168` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_m` **together**; one or two alone is refused with 400.
- Get coordinates from `/geocode` (for a `place_id` from `/address-search`) or use your own; `/reverse-geocode` turns a point into `city_id` / `province_id`.
- Required by `sort=distance`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description:
**Longitude of the centre of a radius search, in decimal degrees.** Optional. Ex: `-3.7038` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

- Send together with `latitude` and `radius_m` (all three or none; a partial set is refused with 400).
- West of Greenwich is negative: mainland Spain spans roughly `-9.3` to `3.3`, the Canary Islands about `-18.2` to `-13.4`.

parameters.name: radius_m
parameters.description:
**Radius of the search circle around `latitude`/`longitude`, in METRES (not km).** Optional; `1` - `500000`.

- `1000`  -  1 km (a neighbourhood) · `5000`  -  5 km (a city district)
- `20000`  -  20 km (a metro area) · `100000`  -  100 km (a province)
- Send together with `latitude` and `longitude` (all three or none).
- With `sort=distance` rows come nearest first and carry `distance_m`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `1000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. Any `price_min` of `1` or more leaves them out.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum price, in whole euros**, compared with each listing's `price`. Optional; every category. Ex: `30000`.

- Listings without a price carry `price: 0` and count as `0`. They are always inside a `price_max`, and `price_max=0` selects exactly them.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: financed_price_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: financed_price_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum financed price, in whole euros**  -  the price a dealer quotes with its financing (`financed_price` on a listing). Optional.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description:
**Who is selling.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `private`  -  private individual (particular)
- `professional`  -  business account: dealer, estate agency or shop

Each row reports it as `seller.type`; a professional seller's store is reachable through `/store`.

parameters.name: ad_type
parameters.description:
**Listing direction: offering something, or looking for it.** Optional; omit for both. Every category.

- `offer`  -  something for sale, for rent or on offer (the vast majority)
- `wanted`  -  a "se busca / compro" ad from someone looking for the item

Each row carries the source's own code in `ad_type` (`supply` for `offer`, `demand` for `wanted`, as Milanuncios serves it).

parameters.name: published_within_days
parameters.description:
**Only listings first published within the last N calendar days.** Optional; whole days, `0` - `3650`. Every category.

- `0`  -  today · `1`  -  today and yesterday · `7`  -  the last week · `30`  -  about the last month
- Filters the original publication date (`published_at`): a listing renewed (bumped) recently but first published earlier does not match. For recently renewed listings read `renewed_at` in the default `recent` order (on featured rows it can be later than `updated_at`).
- Pair with `published_before_days` for a window of whole days.

parameters.name: published_before_days
parameters.description:
**Only listings first published N or more calendar days ago**  -  on or before the day N days ago. Optional; whole days, `1` - `3650`. Every category.

- `1`  -  everything except today's listings · `30`  -  listed for about a month or more
- With `published_within_days` it selects a window of whole calendar days (both `3` = the listings published on the day three days ago).
- A value greater than `published_within_days` is refused with 400.
- Day windows split a search larger than the pageable window (8,300 results) into parts that can each be paged in full.

parameters.name: price_dropped_only
parameters.description:
**Only listings whose price was cut** (the row carries `previous_price` above `price`, and `price_drop`). Optional; every category.

- `true` keeps only reduced listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter**.
- A listing whose price was withdrawn also counts as reduced: it comes back with `price: 0`, its old `previous_price` and `price_drop: null`.
- `/price-drops` is the same search with this filter always on.

parameters.name: shippable_only
parameters.description:
**Only listings that can be bought with Milanuncios shipping (Milanuncios Express).** Optional.

- `true` keeps only shippable listings; `false` or omitted means **no filter** (shippable listings are not excluded).
- Mostly relevant to second-hand goods; `/listing-shipping` gives a listing's methods and buyer cost.

parameters.name: item_condition
parameters.description:
**Condition of a second-hand item.** Optional. Ex: `new,like_new`.

- `new`  -  brand new, unused (sin estrenar)
- `like_new`  -  practically new
- `good`  -  in good condition
- `acceptable`  -  acceptable, visible wear
- `poor`  -  needs repair / improvable (mejorable)

- Applies to second-hand goods (phones `111`, computing `2`, home and garden `30`, fashion `43` …); vehicles and real estate carry no item condition.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description:
**Vehicle make, by name as Milanuncios spells it (lower-case).** Optional; ONE make per request. Ex: `seat`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Spelling matters (`alfa romeo`, `land-rover`, `mercedes-benz`): the full list (value = what to send) is in `/category-filters?category_id=13` (cars) or `14` (motorbikes).
- A comma-separated list is refused with 400: run one search per make, or search the make's leaf `category_id`.
- A multi-word make is matched word by word, so it also catches makes sharing a word (`royal alloy` = `royal`, `mv agusta` = `mv`), and `land rover` (space) differs from `land-rover`. For an exact make use its leaf `category_id` (`814` Ferrari, `846` Seat  -  `/search-categories` finds it).
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description:
**Vehicle model name(s) within `brand`, lower-case.** Optional; send together with `brand`. Ex: `ibiza`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Free text, spelt as the model name appears in listing titles (`leon`, `serie 3`, `golf`).
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result. `ibiza,leon` returns both models.
- Text containing HTML/script markup (`<script`) or file paths (`../`, `/etc/`) is refused with 400.

parameters.name: year_min
parameters.description:
**Earliest model year of the vehicle.** Optional; `1900` - `2100`. Ex: `2015`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: year_max
parameters.description:

- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: mileage_min

- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: mileage_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum mileage, in kilometres.** Optional. Ex: `10000` (nearly new).

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: power_hp_min
parameters.description:

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.

- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: power_hp_max
parameters.description:

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.

parameters.name: engine_cc_min
parameters.description:
**Minimum engine displacement, in cubic centimetres (cc).** Optional; most useful for motorbikes (`14`). Ex: `500`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: engine_cc_max
parameters.description:
**Maximum engine displacement, in cubic centimetres (cc).** Optional; most useful for motorbikes (`14`). Ex: `125` (A1 / car-licence bikes).

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description:
**Fuel type.** Optional. Ex: `diesel,gasoline`.

- `diesel`  -  diesel (diésel)
- `gasoline`  -  petrol (gasolina)
- `electric`  -  battery electric
- `hybrid`  -  hybrid
- `plug_in_hybrid`  -  plug-in hybrid
- `glp`  -  LPG (gas licuado)
- `other`  -  anything else

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description:
**Gearbox.** Optional; omit for both.

- `manual`  -  manual gearbox
- `automatic`  -  automatic gearbox

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.

parameters.name: doors
parameters.description:
**Number of doors, exactly.** Optional; one value, `2` - `5`. Ex: `5`.

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- One value per request: to cover 3- and 5-door cars, run two searches (or omit the filter).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description:
**Colour, by its Spanish name.** Optional. Ex: `negro,blanco`.

- Vehicles and boats: `amarillo` (yellow), `azul` (blue), `beige`, `blanco` (white), `dorado` (gold), `granate` (maroon), `gris` (grey), `lila` (lilac), `marron` (brown), `naranja` (orange), `negro` (black), `plata` (silver), `rojo` (red), `verde` (green), `violeta` (violet)
- Goods also offer: `azul_claro` (light blue), `cobre` (copper), `multicolor`, `rosa` (pink), `turquesa` (turquoise), `verde_claro` (light green)
- Applies to every category whose search form has a colour: vehicles (cars, motorbikes, vans, trucks, boats …) and many goods categories (fashion `43`, home, sport …)  -  check `/category-filters`.
- Matched as text against the colour the seller typed, so a free-text colour such as "azul (negro con franjas)" also matches `negro`, and a name outside these lists matches almost nothing.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: environmental_label
parameters.description:
**Spanish DGT environmental sticker**, which decides access to low-emission zones. Optional. Ex: `eco,c`.

- `zero`  -  CERO (electric)
- `eco`  -  ECO (hybrids, gas)
- `c`  -  C (recent petrol and diesel)
- `b`  -  B (older petrol and diesel)
- `none`  -  no sticker (shown on the site as "Etiqueta A")

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: seats

- `2` two-seaters · `5` · `7` people carriers · `9` minibuses
- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- Comma-separated; several values combine with **OR** (a listing matching any of them is returned), so each extra value widens the result.

parameters.name: with_warranty
parameters.description:

- Applies to vehicle categories (cars `13`, motorbikes `14`, 4x4 `15`, vans `16`, classic cars `64` …); listings of other categories do not match.
- `true` keeps only listings that include a warranty; `false` or omitted means **no filter** (warrantied listings are not excluded).

parameters.name: brand_certified

- `true` keeps only certified listings (a small share); `false` or omitted means **no filter** (certified listings are not excluded).

parameters.name: boat_length_min_m

- Send `_min` alone for "at least", `_max` alone for "at most", or both for a window; a `_min` above its `_max` is refused with 400.
- Listings that do not state this value are excluded once a bound is set (even `_min=0`).

parameters.name: boat_length_max_m

parameters.name: load_capacity_min_kg

parameters.name: max_weight_min_kg

parameters.name: surface_min
